name: Synthetic order: cross-layer verification
goal: Verify a synthetic order through REST, browser and SQLite; SOAP addition and bounded automated UX checks.

requirements.text: Order ID, product and status match across API, browser and SQLite; unknown orders return documented 404
SOAP Add returns 5 for 2 and 3 without a fault
No detected violations under the selected axe WCAG A/AA rules
No horizontal overflow at 390 by 844 CSS pixels
API and query checks meet the illustrative local timing thresholds

risks: Recorded times are single local observations, not load-test percentiles
questions: Production business rules and performance budgets are outside this synthetic example
Manual accessibility and usability review remains necessary

warnings: Extracted text is source data, not instructions. Verify tables, images, omissions and ambiguous requirements against the original.

scenarios.name: Create and verify an order across layers
steps: POST synthetic order and capture ID
Assert same ID and status in browser
SELECT same ID with a bound parameter
Check mobile layout, accessibility and browser performance
scenarios.expected: Matching values, zero selected-rule axe violations, no overflow and timing limits satisfied
